<description>
No fuzz target feeds V2Transport bytes that an honest peer would not send past the v2 key exchange. I add p2p_transport_v2_receive. It knows the transport's keys, builds the input from arbitrary bytes and from parts of a valid handshake (the peer key, garbage, the terminator, encrypted packets that may be corrupted, and runs of empty decoys that force a rekey), and feeds it in pieces of arbitrary size. Once the transport reports v2, it checks that its session id matches the peer's.

It reaches the v2 receive states and their failures, except the fallback to v1 and the wrong-magic disconnect, which need a v1 `version` header at the start of the stream; `p2p_transport_bidirectional_v1v2` reaches the first. 15 minutes with libFuzzer, ASan and UBSan found no crash.
</description>

[2026-11-01] c:6562344437 comment by fametrano:
@uqlidi thanks, all seven comments are applied in 984a01619e.

Once the transport reports v2, the target asserts that its session id matches the peer's; with the check inverted it aborts on the new corpus, so the assert is reached. The old target never rekeyed: a new action appends a run of empty decoys, and replaying the corpora counted 0 rekeys before and 854 after, at about half the exec rate. Both entropies are `const`, from `ConsumeFixedLengthByteVector`. The peer is initialized from `key.EllSwiftCreate(ent)`. `stream` and `aad` hold `std::byte`. The unused bindings are `_more` and `_msg_type`. The refactors read the input the same way: a hash of the stream, the entropy and the bytes left was identical before and after them on all 601 old-corpus inputs with valid keys.

One note on Ralph's report on 0b0fa362fe: its verifier says the target reaches the wrong-magic disconnect. That branch's log line, `net.cpp:1144` at 984a01619e, had 0 hits in the gist's 10-minute run of the new target and its 5-minute run of the final one (`results.txt`). This is why the description says the target does not reach it: that path needs a v1 `version` header at the start of the stream.

I also rebased: master gave `initialize_p2p_transport_serialization` a reachability goal this target never observes, so it now uses `initialize_p2p_transport`. Commands and output: https://gist.github.com/fametrano/b1d9da3c3312cae5b1029679828ee023/e168d09e55328bc3b2955680154ea4b4687b8e5c
